mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4; propranolol may inhibit ivermectin metabolism leading to increased ivermectin levels, with potential additive CNS depression effects.
action: Monitor for signs of ivermectin toxicity (dizziness, ataxia, tremors); consider dose adjustment of ivermectin or alternative beta-blocker if toxicity occurs; no absolute contraindication to concurrent use.
